Risk Title & Description: AI Agent Generates Invalid or Deprecated Terraform HCL Syntax
Root Cause / Trigger: LLM outputting hallucinated arguments, outdated provider syntax, or missing required attributes for GCP resources.
Mitigation Strategy & Preventative Contr: Implement recursive code-validation loop in Cloud Run harness: agent runs 'terraform validate' and syntax linters in a loop to self-correct before opening the PR.
Contingency Plan: Fallback to pre-validated deterministic HCL templates for the 3 demo resource types.

Risk Title & Description: Google Chat Webhook 504 Timeout During Multi-Step Agent Reasoning
Root Cause / Trigger: Google Chat expects HTTP 200 within 3-5 seconds; Cloud Run cold starts + multi-step Agent reasoning take 8-15 seconds.
Mitigation Strategy & Preventative Contr: Asynchronously decouple webhook: immediately return HTTP 200 with an ephemeral 'Generating fix...' card, then post final PR card via Chat API once ready.
Contingency Plan: Cloud Run timeout fallback posts status update to Chat and triggers async retry.

Risk Title & Description: SCC Enterprise Tier / Built-in Gemini Unavailable in Sandbox
Root Cause / Trigger: GCP Sandbox environment lacks paid Enterprise licenses or org-level IAM permissions for native Gemini summaries.
Mitigation Strategy & Preventative Contr: Design pipeline to accept standard SCC findings and fall back to Agent-driven summarization; maintain canned realistic JSON test fixtures.
Contingency Plan: Replay captured production SCC JSON events directly to Pub/Sub via mock publisher script.

Risk Title & Description: Pub/Sub At-Least-Once Delivery Causes Duplicate Chat Spam
Root Cause / Trigger: Pub/Sub message re-delivery or repeat scanner executions generating multiple alerts for the same ongoing vulnerability.
Mitigation Strategy & Preventative Contr: Strict O(1) idempotent deduplication in Firestore using SCC finding.name as Document ID; discard alerts if status is NOTIFIED, ACKNOWLEDGED, or PR_OPEN.
Contingency Plan: Apply Firestore 1-hour silence window TTL to suppress repeat notifications.

Risk Title & Description: Alert Storm Overwhelms Agent Rate Limits & Causes Cost Spikes
Root Cause / Trigger: Bulk GCP resource misconfigurations trigger hundreds of simultaneous alerts, hitting Vertex AI 429 quota limits.
Mitigation Strategy & Preventative Contr: Apply SQL-like export filters in SCC (state='ACTIVE' AND severity='HIGH'); configure Pub/Sub flow control (max 5 outstanding messages) and Cloud Function concurrency limits.
Contingency Plan: Route overflow messages to a dead-letter topic (DLQ) with exponential backoff processing.

Risk Title & Description: Terraform State Drift from Manual Out-of-Band Console Fixes
Root Cause / Trigger: Resource modified directly in GCP Console while PR is pending, desynchronizing the live environment from Git repository state.
Mitigation Strategy & Preventative Contr: Strict GitOps enforcement: bot only opens Pull Requests (no unilateral direct execution); CI pipeline runs 'terraform plan' during PR creation to catch drift.
Contingency Plan: PR reviewer verifies drift warnings before approving merge; re-runs planning if out-of-sync.

Risk Title & Description: Dual-Write Inconsistency Between Firestore and BigQuery
Root Cause / Trigger: Cloud Function crash or transient BigQuery API timeout after updating Firestore, causing analytics divergence from live state.
Mitigation Strategy & Preventative Contr: Leverage native Pub/Sub-to-BigQuery streaming subscription for the analytical audit trail; Firestore handles isolated transactional state updates.
Contingency Plan: Periodic reconciliation query comparing Firestore document states against BigQuery latest snapshots.

Risk Title & Description: Bot Token / Service Account Credential Exposure
Root Cause / Trigger: Git personal access tokens or service account keys accidentally logged or hardcoded in repositories.
Mitigation Strategy & Preventative Contr: Store bot credentials in GCP Secret Manager; enforce least-privilege IAM roles (scoped to target repo PR creation only; no branch deletion or admin rights).
Contingency Plan: Automated Secret Manager secret rotation and immediate token invalidation procedure.

Risk Title & Description: Live Demo Failure Due to API Delays or Network Interruption
Root Cause / Trigger: Presentation venue network lag, SCC scan propagation delay (2-5 mins), or transient GCP API latency during presentation.
Mitigation Strategy & Preventative Contr: Record a pristine, high-definition end-to-end screencast video during Week 8; build an offline fixture replay mode.
Contingency Plan: Instantly switch to high-resolution backup recording with live narration if API response takes >10 seconds.

Risk Title & Description: Scope Creep Overwhelming 8-Week Graduate Capstone Timeline
Root Cause / Trigger: Attempting to build multi-cloud remediations, complex custom web dashboards, or excessive finding categories.
Mitigation Strategy & Preventative Contr: Freeze scope to 3 high-impact GCP misconfigurations (Public Cloud Storage Bucket, Open SSH Firewall, Overprivileged IAM) and utilize BigQuery Canvas / Google Chat cards.
Contingency Plan: Focus strictly on the core alert-to-PR loop as MVP; document additional features as future roadmap extensions.
